verdict.rationale: Convex supports bulk data import via `npx convex import` and lets mutations/queries run arbitrary JS over many documents, and the MCP server lets AI agents call these functions on a deployment. However, there's no documented explicit bulk-write/update/delete API, batch size limits, or a concrete example of an AI agent performing a bulk operation end-to-end. missing for 10: explicit bulk mutation/update/delete API docs, batch operation guarantees/limits, hands-on evidence of an AI agent executing bulk operations via MCP or CLI.
